title: The canonical derived open/scalar comparison is conjugate to the derived restriction square.
statement: Let A and B be arbitrary commutative rings, φ:A→B a ring homomorphism, and j:U→X an open immersion. Form the two composite adjunctions of the fixed derived open adjunctions and chosen derived scalar adjunctions. Conjugation of openScalarExtension φ j under these adjunctions is precisely the hom of openDerivedRestrictScalarsIso φ j. There is no additional flatness hypothesis.

proof.text: The canonical comparison is defined by leftAdjointUniq after transporting the right adjoint of the second composite adjunction along openDerivedRestrictScalarsIso. Expand the formula for leftAdjointUniq and the inverse conjugation equivalence; their components agree. Applying the conjugation equivalence and cancelling its inverse gives the claimed identity.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleOpenScalarDerivedConjugate
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {U X : Scheme.{u}} (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] :
    conjugateEquiv
      ((Adjunction.ofIsRightAdjoint
        (Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars U.smallEtaleTopology φ)).comp
        (derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) j))
      ((derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j).comp
        (Adjunction.ofIsRightAdjoint (Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars X.smallEtaleTopology φ)))
      (openScalarExtension φ j).hom = (openDerivedRestrictScalarsIso φ j).hom
